capability: Confirm exit for selected files before cancelling work or completing persistence
searchEvidence: Owner includes every selected file, explicitly including Report JSON. Reuse WorkflowSessionPresentationViewModel.Slots.HasSelectedInputs across both composition pages, including hidden AB/General/reference and failed or pending inspections. LoadedHexEditorWorkspace avoids eager editor construction. Hex LoadAsync and Report LoadReportFileAsync need a selection projection before their first await; no duplicate byte or validity detection.

MainWindow.OnClosing owns cancellation, persistence completion and final Close recursion; gate before all side effects. Existing explicitly approved Settings activation must retain its stable-launcher handoff/retry path. Cancel exit retains enabled state and live queues; approval is single-use per closing lifecycle.

ShellNavigationViewModel already owns pending destination, cancellation and activation-before-clear transaction. Extend it with pending exit callback and localized action projections. Hex page navigation retains its document and uses non-clearing copy; Report is global and retained across page navigation, so merely restored history does not create spurious prompts.

NavigationClearConfirmationModal and FirmwareIcMismatchModal own the accepted warning-bordered modal visual language, Cancel default, cyclic Tab and Escape. Reuse the existing navigation surface above all other modals with focus restored on cancellation. No generic dialog framework.

Single-path admission: UI-114-STANDARD-FEEDBACK-02 retains MainWindow.axaml and admits topmost navigation overlay; UI-114-HISTORY-CONFIRM-08 retains ReportPresentationViewModel.cs and admits explicit report-file selection tracking. No duplicate mutablePaths in this record. Existing ShellNavigationSystemTests and real ReportControlTestHost lifecycle provide narrow regressions.
semanticOwner: Existing shell navigation/close lifecycle and workflow, Hex and Report selection owners
terminalContract: Empty app closes normally; selected composition, clean/dirty/pending Hex or explicitly loaded/pending/failed Report file requests confirmation. Automatic history restore alone does not. Cancel/Escape preserves inputs, current page, report, operations and persistence. Confirm closes once through existing flush without page clearing. Repeat Close never stacks. Preserve explicitly authorized updater restart. Navigation retains activation-before-clear and keeps Hex state on page changes. Localized existing modal style with safe focus; no firmware, release, commit or external-write authority.

designReview.evidence: R1 owner-approved presentation/lifecycle correction using existing owners; no architecture or firmware contract change.
